component.name: Bob LearnHNS
component.summary: Manage Handshake wallets, names and auctions

description.p: This community package is maintained independently and repackages the official Linux build unmodified.
Bob LearnHNS is a desktop wallet for Handshake. Manage HNS, bid on names, manage DNS records and use the built-in node or SPV mode.

To use a Ledger hardware wallet, grant the app access to connected devices with flatpak override --user --device=all io.github.shadstoneofficial.BobWallet. This override grants access to other devices as well as the Ledger.
To undo the optional permission: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.shadstoneofficial.BobWallet
